description: Source code for MP3 audio extractor in Android's media framework, including functions for resynchronization, metadata extraction, and media track handling.

classes.name: MP3Source
classes.description: Media track helper class for MP3 audio data, handles reading frames and seeking.

classes.name: MP3Extractor
classes.description: Main class for extracting MP3 streams, manages initialization, track count, and metadata.

classes.name: Mp3Meta
classes.description: Structure holding MP3 metadata such as position and header info.

methods.name: Resync
methods.description: Function to resynchronize MP3 stream by scanning for valid frame headers.

methods.name: MP3Extractor::MP3Extractor
methods.description: Constructor initializing MP3 extractor, performing resync and metadata extraction.

methods.name: MP3Extractor::countTracks
methods.description: Returns number of tracks (1 if initialized successfully).

methods.name: MP3Extractor::getTrack
methods.description: Returns the MP3 track helper object.

methods.name: MP3Extractor::getTrackMetaData
methods.description: Provides metadata for the MP3 track.

methods.name: MP3Source::read
methods.description: Reads a frame of MP3 data, handles seeking and sync loss.
